after.quote: NAVER and NVIDIA team plan to expand the initial NVIDIA DSX AI factory buildout at GAK Sejong data center from 55 megawatts to 200 megawatts by 2028.
after.one_line: NVIDIA 新闻稿称，NAVER 与 NVIDIA 计划在 2028 年前将 GAK Sejong 的 NVIDIA DSX AI 工厂建设规模从 55 兆瓦扩大至 200 兆瓦。
after.speaker: NVIDIA Corporation

after.quote: AI Summit — NAVER, NVIDIA and Brookfield today announced a proposed expansion of Korea's sovereign AI factory infrastructure, with planned investments that will grow the initial NVIDIA ® DSX™ AI factory deployment to 200 megawatts — more than tripling the 55-megawatt buildout announced last month.
after.one_line: NVIDIA 于 2026-07-24 称，NAVER、NVIDIA 与 Brookfield 提议扩大韩国主权 AI 工厂基础设施，计划将 NVIDIA DSX AI 工厂部署规模扩大至 200 兆瓦，超过此前公布的 55 兆瓦三倍。
after.speaker: NVIDIA Corporation

after.quote: The expanded infrastructure will be built with the NVIDIA DSX platform at NAVER’s GAK Sejong hyperscale data center in Sejong, South Korea.
after.one_line: NVIDIA 表示，扩建基础设施将采用 NVIDIA DSX 平台，建于 NAVER 位于韩国世宗的 GAK Sejong 超大规模数据中心。
